eli (eng-platform): Heads-up — I pushed a fractional diversion rule to send ~8% of prod traffic to the new rewrite runtime. Seeing a latency spike concentrated in eu-west-1. Config I applied below, rolling back if it looks bad.

eli (eng-platform): ```json
{
  "route_match": {"path_prefix": "/v1/generate"},
  "diversion": {"type": "fractional", "percent": 8, "method": "header_or_cookie", "header": "X-Diverge-Cohort", "cookie": "rwd_cohort", "seed": "request_id % 100"}
}
```

nina (infra): Looking. Are we using a deterministic cohort hash or just request_id modulus?

eli (eng-platform): Right now it's request_id % 100 with a header override. We set cookie fallback when header absent.

jordan (product): That modulus on request_id will bias toward heavy clients (some users send many requests so they skew the sample). :warning:

kevin (eng-platform): Strongly agree. We should prefer consistent hashing on user_id when available, then fallback to request_id. Logs already show top-10 callers are overrepresented in cohort A.

eli (eng-platform): Ugh, that explains eu-west spike — a few heavy customers in that region got routed more. Also noticed some hit quota floors because diverted path hits stricter per-route limits.

nina (infra): I'll add two telemetry tags: `cohort` and `steering_method` on traces and request logs so we can slice. Also will expose them in the console dashboard filters. Pausing ramp until we confirm.

ops-bot: Canary ramp for route /v1/generate paused by infra team at 2026-03-20T14:25:07Z while telemetry is updated.

eli (eng-platform): Thanks. Plan: change seed to `murmur3(user_id) % 100` when user_id present, else `murmur3(request_id) % 100`. Lower rollout to 5% during validation. Patch I will push in 5m:

eli (eng-platform): ```diff
- seed: request_id % 100
+ seed: if user_id then murmur3(user_id) % 100 else murmur3(request_id) % 100
- percent: 8
+ percent: 5
```

jordan (product): Also add regression alerts scoped to cohort=*diverted* for 95th latency and error-rate. And ensure we apply a per-user quota floor so diverted traffic doesn't unexpectedly throttle heavy users.

kevin (eng-platform): Will add a small per-customer min_tokens_per_minute guard in the routing layer and a telemetry baseline check before any further ramp.

eli (eng-platform): Cool — I'll hold further ramps until infra confirms tags live and console filters work. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
